result.title: FasterGRN: Reducing the Refinement Redundancy for Accelerating Generative Refinement Networks
result.summary: Departing from the paradigm of diffusion and autoregressive models, Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) enables high-quality image generation through iterative refinements. However, this repeated processing over the entire visual representations results in substantial computation overhead. Furthermore, the binary representations and global refinement mechanism in GRN disable the direct application of acceleration strategies developed for other generative models. To accelerate GRN model, we first observe several key properties by analyzing the entire generative process. That includes the stage characteristic, dual branch similarity and more importantly, the $\textbf{refinement redundancy}$. Motivated by the observations, we present $\textbf{FasterGRN}$, a training-free acceleration method for the Generative Refinement Network. $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ first divides the GRN into the semantic establishment stage and detail refinement stage according to its semantic establishment. For alleviating the refinement redundancy mainly resulting from the detail refinement stage, we propose Adaptive Retention Expansion ($\textbf{ARE}$) and Selective Token Freezing ($\textbf{STF}$) to shrink refinement steps and reduce token computations, respectively. In the experiments on GenEval and DPG-Bench benchmarks, our method $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ achieves a $2.03\times$ sampling speedup while largely preserving image generation performance. Our evaluation on COCO datasets additionally demonstrates that $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ even outperforms the original GRN in image fidelity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 Generative Refinement Networks 迭代细化带来的计算冗余，提出免训练加速方法 FasterGRN：按语义建立与细节细化划分阶段，并用自适应保留扩展和选择性 token 冻结减少细化步数与 token 计算。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按阶段识别细化冗余并冻结部分 token 的做法，可能为 LVR 中动态分配 latent 更新计算、判断何时停止细化提供可核查线索，但该文面向图像生成，迁移性尚不确定。
